title: buff the truestrike
author: projectkepler-ru
body:
## About The Pull Request
20 damage for 35 AP instead of 15 damage for 30 AP. Also increase the bouncing aim range to 4
## Why It's Good For The Game

15 damage for 30 AP was extremely underwhelming for something that used bluespace crystal and need exotic ammo tech. Even if that isn't necessarily the rarest thing in the world. It seems like a pretty strange commitment to make when you can just shoot at a guy until he dies with the regular ammo  which are not that expensive, plus flare shot (basically the defacto laser .38 anyway) does 20 damage and is pretty epic

changes.text: .38 Truestrike now does 20 damage and has better AP.

title: Removes spear breaking
author: necromanceranne
body:
## About The Pull Request

Entirely removes spear breaking mechanics.

## Why It's Good For The Game

Wasn't really as good a limitation as I thought, and mostly just pissed people off. People don't actually use spears against people as much as you'd think, which is a shame. Hell, people don't even use it for the reach. They should, but I can't make people use it. One for the folk in the know I guess.

But as a consequence, this predominantly hurt their functionality when used to break objects. And people more often used them to break objects. (ignore that it has a demolish malice, people do not see the numbers). Which usually has more integrity than a single spear.

So generally speaking, giving spears 'pseudo-ammo' was mostly just a colossal pain in the ass for their most common use, and may have also just actively discouraged their use as weapons further.

changes.text: Spears no longer break from overuse without repair.

title: fix orbit menu crashing if a borg's `mind.assigned_role.tgui_icon` is null
author: Absolucy
body:
## About The Pull Request

if a borg's `mind.assigned_role.tgui_icon` is null, `mind_job_icon` gets passed to ui data as null, and the tgui `<Icon>` freaks out because it was passed null instead of an icon name, and shits itself trying to actually check the icon name.

so this just makes it so that if there's no `tgui_icon`, it defaults to a question mark. simple as that.

changes.text: Fixed the existence of borgs sometimes causing the orbit menu to crash.

title: Malf AI UI now shows hacked APC count
author: PapaMichae1
body:
## About The Pull Request

DM was already sending this to tgui but it was never rendered, so this is probably just an oversight

## Why It's Good For The Game

You need 10 APCs to delta and counting to 10 is very hard

changes.text: The AI Malfunction UI now shows the number of currently hacked APCs

title: Fixes a bug where chat wouldn't scroll all the way and you'd have to constantly manually scroll
author: PapaMichae1
body:
## About The Pull Request

https://github.com/tgstation/tgstation/pull/97613 Introduced a bug where the chat wouldn't scroll down all the way, requiring you to manually scroll, specifically on chat messages that wouldn't wrap without the name, but would wrap with the name. So lets use the magic React function to fix this

changes.text: Chat should scroll properly on some messages that wrap now.

title: ADD: Build Mode - Build Panel
author: KOCMODECAHTHUK
body: ## Описание изменений Добавлен новый режим в Build Mode: Build Panel - панель с браузером всех турфов/мобов/объектов/предметов в билде. При выборе предмета создается прозрачный чертеж (призрак) объекта. Управление работает по аналогии с Adv-Mode: - ЛКМ - поставить выбранный объект. - ПКМ - очистить выбор. - Alt+ЛКМ - скопировать объект в выбор. - Alt+ПКМ - удалить объект. В Build Panel при активной кнопке pixel доступна точечная установка предметов по пикселям. ## Причина создания ПР / Почему это хорошо для игры Это чертовский важное обновление, тк меня уже бесит что если я что-то должен найти то искать в файлах либо в коде. Добавляет удобства и что главное упрощает всю дальнейшую разработку в целом. ## Демонстрация изменений / Тестирование Build Panel: Pixel-Shift mode:

changes.text: В Build Mode добавлена Build Panel - браузер всех объектов билда с категориями и поиском.
Build Panel - Добавлена точечная установка предметов по пикселям (через Shift / кнопку pixel).
